junk_imagery.evidence: No photos or AI images in any frame; everything is flat vector chart art plus the mascot (hook@0.3 through payoff@-0.4).

decorative_mascot.evidence: Data never causes any of the motion: at seg0:mid he hovers between the bars with his arms raised, at seg1:start through seg1:end he sits on top of a 70% bubble, at seg2:mid he slides down the line, and at seg4:start through seg4:end he stands at the foot of the 2001-2003 building and waves. None of it is a setup, action and payoff tied to the stat.

bare_number_card.evidence: In seg1:start through seg1:end the beat is two identical yellow circles that each say "70%", which is just a number on a blob. The 35% from the script never appears.

dead_air.evidence: Measured longest_static_s is 0.0 and something animates in every sampled frame. The closing buildings do only grow slowly (seg4:start to payoff@-0.4).

empty_void.evidence: In seg1:mid the top ~40% of the frame above the bubbles is empty dark gradient. In seg4:start the space between the title and the buildings is mostly dead dark ground.

unreadable.evidence: At seg0:end the mascot's head sits on top of the ~20-years-ago "72%" label, which reads as "?2%". In hook@0.3 the yellow glowing caption "Your twenty-something" bleeds and is hard to read.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Two identical yellow circles both read "70%" and are both captioned "~20 years ago". The kicker reads "~20 YEARS AGO TOPS THE LIST". The 35% that the narration says ("70% to 35%") is never drawn, and a stray cyan ellipse floats inside the left circle at seg1:end.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The second data point was bound to the first point's value and label, so the comparison has nothing to compare. The bubble machine is also a generic size comparison with nothing about drinking in it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show 70% shrinking to 35% for 18-20 year-olds with the right labels on each side, for example a crowd of 10 young-adult figures where half put their drinks down, with Data taking the glasses away himself. The second value must visibly be half of the first and be labelled "recent".

depictions.note: A horizontal bar chart of 72/59/50% with the mascot perched on it. Plain bars and nothing about drinking.
Two identical 70% bubbles. The data binding is broken, so the picture shows no decline at all.
A line chart from 67% to 61% whose y-axis is cropped so a 6-point drop looks like a cliff. The mascot slides along the line.
The closing shows 67/64/61% as near-equal buildings with windows, so the picture undercuts "sober is the norm". The buildings have nothing to do with drinking.

grades.one_line: The core comparison scene is broken (two identical 70% bubbles, 35% never shown), and the rest is stock bar and line charts with a mascot who just hangs around.
problems: seg1: both bubbles read "70%" and "~20 years ago", so the 70%-to-35% drop the narration states is never shown.
seg0:end: the mascot covers the "72%" value label.
The hook (hook@0.3 to hook@2.2) is a static ranked list of three mascots with percentages. The motion is weak and the glowing caption bleeds.
seg2 cuts off the y-axis so 67% to 61% reads as a steep crash.
The closing (seg4) ends on 67/64/61% buildings that look almost equal, which contradicts the "sober is becoming the norm" payoff.
Data never causes any motion. He perches, hovers, slides and waves in every scene.
Nothing in any picture is about drinking (no glasses, bottles or people). Every scene is a generic chart form.
fixes: Fix the data binding in seg1: label the second bubble "recent" with 35% and make it visibly half the size, or redraw it as glasses being set down.
Keep the mascot's bounding box clear of every value label.
Open on immediate motion tied to the subject, for example a row of raised glasses where Data lowers 22 of every 100.
Start the weekly-drinking axis at 0, or show the small drop honestly as a small change.
Close on the strongest number (70% to 35%) instead of the 67/64/61% weekly series.
Give Data an agent act in each scene: he removes glasses, drains a pitcher to the level, or pushes the bar down.
